Upstairs you have a beautiful owner suite that offers a balcony to your backyard oasis and 3 large guestrooms.The backliving space offers plenty of room to entertain with a beautiful outdoor kitchen space with granite coutertops and a beautiful deck to enjoy the view of your 2 plus acres of hill country. If you are in need of storage this home offers that with a large shed for storage. In the detached features a heated/cooled garage office. The property backs up to a relaxing creek. Livestock are permitted, fenceing is horse freedly.
